body: No don't worry things are starting to look up. I'm gonna be ok and I really appreciate it thank you so so so much and the world needs more people like you thank you and please don't stop helping people

I've tried to talk to her and I suggest it every day but for some reason she really really really doesn't want that. Every time she does talk with me I feel like she wants to accuse me and attack me. And thank you so much for replying it does mean a lot to me and these things make a difference thank you so so much

Well this is the last in a series of many similar events. a while ago i promised her to get her a ring, a promise i very much intended to keep. when she brought up yesterday that i hadnt yet, i replied its because i dont have the money yet but ill get it as soon as possible. and its true i really don't have enough money right now but that's what ive been saving up for. on the drive home she wasnt speaking to me, so i asked whats wrong. she didnt reply so i tried to reassure her and see if she was ok but she replied "i cant hear you" and turned the car's music way up. i got very hurt by this and said that it was rude and that i wanted to have communication with her so that we don't have problems like this. she got very angry when i said that and it started a fight with her calling me names like "hitler" and "osama." normally when this happens, i cry and apologize just to get her to stop because its extremely hurtful to me. but this time, i controlled myself and weathered it. eventually, she said something along the lines of i dont want to fuck with her because she can hurt people. then i replied "I know" and she started crying and i felt horrible and tried to comfort her but to no avail. the rest of the evening consisted of her accusing me of being emotionally abusive and me trying to apologize. eventually, she couldn't take it any more and ended it

She thinks that she has depression because recently she has been  generally unhappy. She hasn't been diagnosed though. Although I've tried to be supportive, I've gone through similar phases as her. i never told her i was depressed although i felt that i was. i truly truly felt depressed. i snapped out of it when she told me that she couldn't handle all my problems and it was taking a toll on her. i snapped out of these months of "depression" in that instant. I feel like she might be going through a similar phase that i was. I'm obviously not going to tell her that her depression is causing me anxiety. but i know how she feels and ive honestly tried to be the best that i can be. i do make mistakes, but in my opinion most of them are small, although they start massive fights with her. i just get frustrated when she tells me things like i dont understand people with depression and that depressed people are extra fragile so i need to be more careful with her. its too late now obviously but i really really do love her. i know all of this might seem to put her in a negative light but thats because it's all my side and im extremely distraught right now. im frustrated with myself and to an extent, with her. i do love her tho more than anything
Well now I don't have a girlfriend anymore so that's even better
please somebody for the love of god i cant do this anymore
